extra.notes: Employees: approximately 13,000 full-time at 12/31/2015. Faiveley Transport: announced 27-Jul-2015, definitive share purchase agreement with ~51% Faiveley family holders signed 6-Oct-2015 (EUR 100/share, 25-45% cash at holders' election, remainder Wabtec stock; then tender offer for public shares); Faiveley annual sales about $1.2bn. Cash of $202.9m held in escrow at 12/31/15 for the acquisition. 2015 share repurchases: 4.9m shares for $388m. Purchase prices net of cash acquired.
